title: Filtered colimits of injective etale sheaves are globally acyclic
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme of universe u [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let I be a small filtered category with objects and morphisms in universe u+1, and J an I-diagram of abelian sheaves on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with section groups in universe u+1. Suppose each J_i is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For any colimit cocone c of J [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and integer q > 0, the q-th right derived functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] of global sections [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor] evaluated on c.pt is a zero object. No torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0739 (lemma-colim-works-over-collection), proof, last paragraph: acyclicity of the colimit of injectives; qcqs etale basis of Tag 03Q5; checked against https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0739 on 2026-10-12

proof.text: Let B be the qcqs objects of X.Etale and let Cov be the finite covering families with base and members in B. For iterated fibre products use the already-proved source-library Scheme.compactSpace_and_quasiSeparatedSpace_piObj: it implements qcqs morphism permanence, base change and finite products. For cofinality use the already-proved stronger Scheme.exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology on an arbitrary qcqs etale object U, applied to Sieve.ofArrows of the given covering. Lift its Fin m index to Type (u+1), take the affine members (hence qcqs), and extract the refinement arrows using Sieve.ofArrows.exists. Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff verifies joint surjectivity of the lifted family. This replaces the separate cofinal-coverings import, whose statement is restricted to the identity object of the scheme under discussion.

Prove the private helper abelianSectionsColimit for I : Type (u+1). Take R = ULift.{u+1} Z and the coefficient equivalence U from ModuleCat R to AddCommGrpCat, given by restricting scalars along the inverse ULift ring equivalence and forgetting the Z-module structure. sheafCompose U is fully faithful and essentially surjective, hence an equivalence. Transport J and its supplied cocone along the inverse equivalence. Apply etale_sections_filtered_colimit on any qcqs object; bijectivity gives an isomorphism of the canonical comparison and hence a colimit evaluation cocone. Apply U and transport through the sheaf equivalence counit to obtain the original abelian evaluation cocone. Quantifying over all diagrams yields PreservesColimitsOfShape I for evaluation on each qcqs object.

Prove, rather than import or postpone, the coefficient-size finite Cech homology preservation calculation in four private helpers. First use exact filtered colimits in AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}, hence colim.PreservesHomology, and ShortComplex.functorEquivalence to prove that ShortComplex.homologyFunctor preserves I-colimits. Naturality of mapHomologyIso identifies the canonical image cocone. Pass to complexes by the three evaluations defining shortComplexFunctor. Each degree of the finite-cover Cech complex is a finite product of the evaluations at its covering fibre products. Functor-category evaluation detects colimits; the finite product functor preserves them because it is naturally isomorphic to the finite coproduct functor in abelian groups. Pi.isoLimit and its naturality identify this degreewise computation with the actual Cech functor, so HomologicalComplex.preservesColimitsOfShape_of_eval gives preservation for complexes. Compose with homology preservation. In the main theorem install the sections-preservation hypotheses from Step 2 and qcqs closure from Step 1. Each J_i has zero positive Cech homology by injective_sheaf_cech_acyclic. Thus J followed by Cech homology is a zero diagram; isColimitOfPreserves applied to the supplied hc has zero vertex. Apply isZero_rightDerived_etale_of_cech_vanishing to B, Cov and c.pt to conclude positive derived-evaluation vanishing.

Take T = Etale.mk (identity X), which belongs to B by the two hypotheses on X. MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal proves it terminal. Sheaf.GammaNatIsoSheafSections (Lean name Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections) identifies global sections with evaluation at T. Apply NatTrans.rightDerived to both directions of that isomorphism, using rightDerived_comp and rightDerived_id to verify the inverse laws. Transport the zero object given by the Cech criterion through the component of this derived isomorphism at c.pt. The supplied arbitrary colimit cocone is used throughout, so no identification with a chosen colimit or small-index restriction is necessary.

mathlib_searches.query: Filtered colimits of injective etale sheaves on a quasi compact quasi separated scheme are acyclic for global sections
A filtered colimit of injective sheaves on an etale site is acyclic for global sections over a quasi compact quasi separated scheme
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits; K-injectivity of bounded below injective complexes, Grothendieck abelianness of sheaf categories, and scheme global sections of inverse limits. No theorem on acyclicity of filtered injective-sheaf colimits.
Only HasPointwiseRightDerivedFunctorAt.hasColimit, which concerns construction of pointwise derived functors. No matching injective-colimit acyclicity theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: positive sheaf cohomology vanishes for direct limits of injective objects on a coherent site
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: K-injective and injective resolution facts, sheaf cohomology definitions. No filtered injective-colimit acyclicity statement. Second reading rg found the existing smaller-index EtaleFilteredInjectiveAcyclic theorem, but its I : Type u cannot accept the present I : Type (u+1).

theorem isZero_rightDerived_globalSections_colimit_of_injective_coefficientSize
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    {J : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    (hinjective : ∀ i, Injective (J.obj i)) {c : Cocone J} (hc : IsColimit c)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsZero (((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerived q).obj
      c.pt)
